berserk_mcp:bzrk_search.note: runs a user query through the boundary, since-window check and query semaphore, then bzrk. The boundary checks moved unchanged to _kql_boundary.check on 2026-09-24 (differential test over ~120k queries and 6 table names: identical results). No dedicated review yet.

berserk_mcp:_run_argv_bounded.note: scans all of stderr for the auth marker while streaming (512-byte overlap, bounded patterns), reports streams_complete (finding 3: a marker past the retained cap was discarded). Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

berserk_mcp:_resolve_bzrk_binary.note: BZRK_BIN resolved once; Windows CWD executable planting refused. Fingerprint recorded 2026-09-23; no dedicated review yet.

berserk_mcp:_dispatch_tools_call.note: role-visibility gate (F-008) and modern preflight before handle_call; output filter applied. 2026-09-22: two passes over b648346..d545097 found it equivalent to the pre-refactor tools/call branch

berserk_mcp:_fence_untrusted.note: delegates tag neutralisation to _tag_guard (open and close tags). Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

secret_scan:redact.note: bounded, fail-closed redaction. Codex Security scoped scan 2026-09-24 of secret_scan.py/_http.py/_store.py (9 findings, coverage complete): finding 1 (quoted JSON keys, github_pat_) and finding 2 (quadratic private-key regex) fixed; findings 7 (scan_secrets counted a limit as a secret) and 8 (zero-width EXTRA_PII_PATTERNS match) fixed 2026-09-24 in scan_secrets and _pii_matches.

_http:validate_http_url.note: outbound URL rules. Codex Security scoped scan 2026-09-24 of secret_scan.py/_http.py/_store.py (9 findings, coverage complete): finding 6 (LLM opt-in applied to OTLP/CanonLoom) fixed in the JSON wrappers and callers; finding 4 (ambient proxy could route validated loopback HTTP off host) fixed 2026-09-24: loopback requests use a proxy-free opener.

_store:validate_store_path.note: store paths absolute, traversal-free, control-free. Codex Security scoped scan 2026-09-24 of secret_scan.py/_http.py/_store.py (9 findings, coverage complete): finding 3 (validation not bound to later operations; FileLock uses the unresolved path) and finding 5 (follows planted symlinks) still open; finding 9 (codex adapter state path) fixed 2026-09-24.

_kql_boundary:check.note: final KQL execution boundary: semicolons, control commands, table prefix, and now mandatory source confinement via source_violation in every validation mode (finding 1: union/in (Table) read other tables). Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_kql_boundary:strip_literals.note: blanks string literals the way the Kusto lexer reads them ('..'/".." with backslash escapes, verbatim @'..' with doubled quotes, h/H prefixes, ``` multi-line); unterminated literals return None and are refused. Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_kql_boundary:source_violation.note: source operators/functions anywhere outside literals, plus literal-only right operands of in/has-family operators. Residual: stored function in scalar context (documented in SECURITY.md). Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_kql_boundary:_literal_group_error.note: linear scan of a parenthesised operand: literals only; brackets only inside dynamic(); ':' only inside dynamic/datetime/time/timespan. Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_kql_boundary:_literal_operand_error.note: unparenthesised operand: string, number, true/false/null or a literal function whose contents pass _literal_group_error. Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_tag_guard:neutralize.note: neutralises forged open/close fence tags after canonical decoding; used by _fence_untrusted, _saved_query_description and parser_factory._fence_sample_data (finding 2: entity-encoded tag names escaped the fence). Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_tag_guard:_canonical.note: NFKC + HTML entity + \uXXXX/\xXX/\/ + URL decoding, up to 8 rounds; unstable text has its escape characters broken. Linear on 10 MiB adversarial input. Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

_tag_guard:tag_pattern.note: tag regex over canonical text; one gap run per position to avoid quadratic backtracking (24 s -> 0.18 s on 10 MiB of invisible characters). Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.

berserk_mcp:run_bzrk.note: constant auth message when the marker is anywhere in stderr; fails closed when a stream was not fully read. Fix for Codex Security scan 77004e6e (2026-09-25); fixes reviewed by Codex in two passes, second pass clean.
